_comment: Template. `cairn install claude-code` substitutes the __CAIRN_*__ placeholders
__CAIRN_PYTHON__ becomes the absolute path of the interpreter that ran the
install, and __CAIRN_ENQUEUE_PY__ the absolute path of the copied hook script.
Both are absolute on purpose: Claude Code spawns a hook command directly, so a
bare `cairn` is not found unless it happens to be on PATH, and a .sh file cannot
be executed at all on Windows (EFTYPE). That makes settings.json machine-specific;
each checkout runs `cairn install claude-code` for itself.
